note: Fixed before any evaluation-seed run. Calibration seeds 1000-1002 (N=32), 1010-1012 (N=64); pilot seed 1100 (debugging, gamma choice); evaluation seeds 2000-2002.

scc.certified_quantity: open-loop H-step pit-fall probability (failure-cost component of the planner score) of the executed plan
scc.residual: R = pT - pf, pT from 200 fresh true-simulator particles, pf = model fall probability of the executed plan (8 chained-CRN particles)
scc.tau: kappa*b = 0.30 cost units (commit iff U <= b on the probability scale)
scc.stage2_candidates: executed plan + top-3 members by planner score
scc.stage2_choice: argmin of total planner score with 64 fresh independent particles
scc.pointwise_band: residuals of 4 random final-population members (stage 1) / the 4 candidates (stage 2)

aci.err: 1[F_replay > U] for committed steps, F_replay = counterfactual open-loop replay of the committed plan on the realised wind of the next H steps

equal_compute_arm: base N=43 (3*43*8*10 = 10320 rows per env step = SCC rows per env step)

protocol.shift: burn-in 200 steps at 0.09 (stateful arms only), then restart at 0.13
